description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for the LibXDiff library, a file differential library. It includes configuration options, data types for files and buffers, and function signatures for diff and merge operations.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two files using specified parameters and configuration.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Merges two files with a common ancestor based on provided parameters.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first part of the memory-mapped file and its size.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory-mapped file.
